answer: Proof-of-stake mechanisms mitigate Sybil attacks by tying agent identity to capital ownership rather than ephemeral identifiers. By requiring a saffron collateral deposit held in a cross-chain bridge, the system forces attackers to incur massive financial risk. An adversary posing as a raven of illicit identities must lock significant value, ensuring that any attempt to flood the network with fake agents incurs a prohibitive cost, rendering malicious behavior economically irrational.
